name: Studio Stickman
description: Stick figure animation from text: scenes are YAML (figures, poses and actions on a timeline, props, camera, words, sound effects) rendered to MP4/GIF/WebM with a contact sheet to look at; sprite sheets for games. Fights, dialogues, dances on the beat of a studio-daw song. Extensible with Python plugins (poses, actions, props, backdrops, sounds).

commands.description: validate fast (names, parameters, reach and timing warnings)
contact sheet PNG of the key moments — look at it before rendering
render to exports/<name>.mp4 with sound (+ contact sheet PNG to look at)
transparent sprite sheet + atlas JSON for games
what scenes can use (built-ins, plugins, packs) with parameters
extend the tool with your own Python (plugins/stickman/)
